insight: The drag-and-drop counterpart to code-first frameworks — it builds on LangChain/LlamaIndex nodes, so anything they support, it can wire.
name: Flowise
tagline: Visually build AI agents and LLM workflows — drag-and-drop, self-hosted.
description: A low-code visual builder for AI agents, chatflows, and multi-agent systems on a drag-and-drop canvas. It self-hosts locally through npm or Docker, or deploys to major clouds, and is provider-agnostic across many LLMs via its node ecosystem. The core is Apache-2.0; a managed Flowise Cloud tier exists, making it freemium.

modelSupport.notes: Provider-agnostic via LangChain/LlamaIndex nodes; exact set depends on installed nodes.
